source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, Astika sub-parva, adhyaya 15 (Kadru and Vinata see Uchchaihshravas; Sauti, asked where the horse came from, tells of Meru, the gods' wish for the amrita and Narayana's counsel to churn the ocean with the asuras).
structure: From episode 11: COLD OPEN (the hook over the episode's strongest image, big on-screen text from frame 1; KIT.series.hookCard) → title (the hook's post) → RECAP (≈2.5 s) → STORY (with a brief cut to Sauti at the Naimisha fire) → the cliffhanger image + line → a silent ≈1.5 s Next card that dissolves back into the first frame (KIT.series.loopNextScene).

strings.nextTitle: A Mountain for a Churning Stick
strings.amritaEpithet: the drink that frees from death

voice.note: speaker → script/cast.json (voice, speed, pitch). Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice), say (what is spoken, if not `text`). captionY (px or "high") lifts the caption above low action.

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: Where did this horse come from?
lines.say: Where did this horse come from?
lines.note: COLD OPEN (frame 1 already moving): the white horse surges out of breaking surf at night, the Naimisha fire licking up from the bottom edge; the question in big text from frame 1 (KIT.series.hookCard; caption off). beats = 'horse' (he breaks the surface), 'from'. The title in the post.

lines.text: Vinata's son Aruna became the red of dawn.
lines.say: Vinata's son Aruna became the red of dawn.
lines.note: RECAP (short, after the hook): episode 10's key image as a memory: Aruna at the reins of the Sun's chariot.

lines.text: At sunrise, the sisters Kadru and Vinata saw him on the shore.
lines.say: At sunrise, the sisters Kadru and Vinata saw him on the shore.
lines.note: STORY 1. The shore at sunrise, the two sisters LARGE in the foreground (Kadru left, Vinata right) turning; between them, far out, the horse walks out of the shining water. beats = 'sunrise' (the sun clears the sea), 'Kadru' (she turns), 'Vinata', 'him' (the horse lifts his head).

lines.text: Uchchaihshravas, king of horses, honoured by the gods.
lines.say: Uchchaihshravas, [p:250] king of horses, honoured by the gods.
lines.note: STORY 2. Close: the horse large in profile walking left along the surf, mane and tail streaming; his name in gold (pre: a 300 ms rest, bell on the name). On 'gods' small devas appear in the clouds above with lotus garlands, bowing. beats = name, 'horses', 'gods'.

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: He rose from the ocean, when it was churned.
lines.say: He rose from the ocean, [p:80] when it was churned.
lines.note: FRAME (Sauti at the Naimisha fire, the sages leaning in). Above the fire a SOLID vision medallion opens (EP11.roundel, a gold ring, not a ghost): a mountain whirling in a white sea. beats = 'ocean' (the roundel opens), 'churned' (it turns).

lines.text: It began on Meru, the golden mountain, where the gods sat in council.
lines.say: It began on Meru, the golden mountain, where the gods sat in council.
lines.note: STORY 3. NEW PLACE: Meru blazing white-gold, rays from the peak; the camera tilts down the stepped mountain (beats[0]) to the terrace where six devas stand (beats[2]); Meru's name card.

lines.text: They longed for the amrita, the drink that frees from death.
lines.say: They longed for the amrita… [p:100] the drink that frees from death.
lines.note: STORY 4. Closer on the devas, faces lifted; in a roundel above them a white pot pours light. beats = 'amrita' (the roundel), 'death' (its light flares). Caption at the default (bottom), below the medallion.

lines.speaker: vishnu
lines.text: Churn the ocean, gods and asuras together, and the amrita will rise.
lines.say: Churn the ocean, [p:120] gods and asuras together… [p:100] and the amrita will rise.
lines.note: STORY 5 · THE TURN (≈ 55 %): Narayana himself, frontal and large, the gold aureole opening behind him; Brahma on his lotus at the left listening. A 350 ms rest before, a bell on 'Churn'. beats = 'Churn' (he raises his hand), 'asuras', 'rise' (the discus flares).

lines.text: Gods and asuras, old rivals, side by side.
lines.say: Gods and asuras, [p:100] old rivals, [p:60] side by side.
lines.note: STORY 6. A split composition: the devas file in from the left (pearl-gold), then on 'asuras' (a low drum) the asuras stride in from the right (ember), and they stand face to face across the shore. beats = 'Gods', 'asuras', 'side'.

lines.text: Before them lay the ocean, full of jewels and monsters.
lines.say: Before them lay the ocean, full of jewels and monsters.
lines.note: STORY 7. NEW PLACE: the cosmic ocean at night, deep blue, the horizon silver; the camera sinks to the waterline: jewels glinting in the depths (beats[1]) and a makara surfacing (beats[2]).

lines.text: To churn an ocean, they needed a mountain for a stick and a serpent for a rope.
lines.say: To churn an ocean, [p:200] they needed a mountain for a stick, [p:120] and a serpent for a rope.
lines.note: NEXT 1 (cliffhanger image): over the dark sea a vast mountain silhouette rises (beats[1] 'mountain') and a serpent's coil shines around it (beats[3] 'rope').

lines.text: Next: A Mountain for a Churning Stick
lines.note: The short, silent Next card (≈1.6 s, KIT.series.loopNextScene): a glimpse of episode 12 (Mandara lifted from the earth by the serpent Ananta), then the fire rises and the first frame returns (loop).
